tasks.title: eval: three tested toolkit utilities
tasks.prompt:
Add three small, well-tested utilities to the toolkit, following the repo's existing conventions (ESM, strict TS, exported from src/index.ts, Node's built-in test runner):
1. In src/async.ts, add `timeout<T>(promise: Promise<T>, ms: number): Promise<T>` that rejects with a clear error if the promise doesn't settle within ms (and clears its timer on success).
2. In src/arrays.ts, make `chunk` throw a clear error when size <= 0 instead of looping forever / returning wrong results.
3. In src/numbers.ts, add `range(start: number, end: number): number[]` returning integers [start, end) (empty when start >= end).
Export all new functions, and add tests covering each — including the timeout rejection and the chunk error case.
